additional_info.subject: ID0382002-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117073] FailsafeMode_Active CRM:00315001835

Hi Emre-abi,
It seems like the charger is operational now. The reason why it was in Failsafemode was because of the missing communication to KF12 SECC_DC2.
I did the rollout of the next FW version. If you want I can update it.
Let me know your thoughts.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
